title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Sales Development agent books seller meetings for prospects
summary: The scheduling description and target match the roadmap, and Microsoft documentation supports the activation and blocking controls. Preview billing is correctly separated from unpublished scheduling-specific general-availability terms. Minor corrections should name the activation API's deciding properties in the control note and acknowledge conflicting Frontier enrollment prerequisites.
